notes: The italic *and* at t015 is the one added unit: it stands between `רֶכֶב` and `עַם`, which the Hebrew juxtaposes with no conjunction, while every other English connective in the verse answers to a written waw (rule 14's closing sentence).
s029 `מַּעַלְ` keeps *brought ... up* discontinuous around the object suffix's *thee*, headed on the lexical verb because a phrasal particle names nothing on its own (rule 44).
